# SHAREOK - Interdisciplinary Journal of Signage and Wayfinding

> > Open-access scholarly repository hosting the Interdisciplinary Journal of Signage and Wayfinding, dedicated to advancing research in signage systems, wayfinding design, and visual communication.

SHAREOK serves as the digital publishing platform for peer-reviewed research exploring the intersection of urban design, traffic management, and human-centered wayfinding solutions. The journal is supported by the Academic Advisory Council for Signage Research and Education (AACSRE) and features contributions from international researchers in environmental psychology, urban planning, and communication design.

## Key Topics

- Signage design and systems
- Wayfinding research
- Visual communication
- Urban design and navigation
- Traffic signs and safety
- Open-access publishing
- Interdisciplinary research methodology
- Environmental psychology
- AACSRE (Academic Advisory Council for Signage Research and Education)
- Human-centered design
- Spatial cognition
- Transportation infrastructure
- Universal design principles

## Journal Home

- [Interdisciplinary Journal of Signage and Wayfinding](https://ijsw.shareok.org/): Homepage for open-access journal on signage and wayfinding research
